findings.desc: concept-scope: CHK-004/CHK-005 promise a mechanical per-run decisions-doc read log plus self-report mismatch diagnostics, but the implementation only adds pure helper functions and a synthetic smoke. rg shows captureReviewerReadEvent/normalizeReviewerReadLog/diagnoseReviewerReadEvidence are referenced only from packages/main/src/core/reviewer-read-evidence.ts and packages/main/src/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.ts, not from review_run_start, review_pass_set, finding_add, dispatch, or any persisted reviewer-run evidence path. As a result no real reviewer run records a read-log digest and no mismatch/full-scan diagnostic can be emitted from runtime review evidence. Fix by wiring capture/persistence to the reviewer-run/evidence path and invoking diagnostics against the submitted readManifest.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by c129db7b3 and verified at 73e5eadcc/cffcfad: review_pass_set and reviewer finding_add now accept real mechanical readEvents/readLog, persist readLog digest/summary plus readDiagnostics, include read evidence in signatures where present, and focused/full validation passed after the fix.
